observations.title: Ride a supported cable
observations.player_action: Hold a supported attachment tool, aim at a compatible chain and hold right-click.
observations.outcome: Attach to the cable and zip along it; looking influences travel direction.
conditions: External author documentation is not proof of effective JEM behavior; compare the installed version and configuration before implementation.
Exact installed mods.toml points to evanbones/Ziplines-Rezipped; original Fabric project was excluded as owning source.
